paper_metadata.title: The tensile response of Mo, Mo–Re and Mo–Si solid solutions
paper_metadata.journal: Int. Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials

evidence.quote: The Mo–Re solid solution is significantly stronger than Mo and retains the strength to at least 800 °C.
The recrystallized Mo–0.3 at.% Si alloy is softer than pure Mo at room temperature and has high ductility (~ 60% tensile elongation).
Recrystallized, commercially pure Mo, binary Mo–27 at.% Re, and as-extruded and variously annealed Mo–0.3 at.% Si alloys were tested in uniaxial tension as a function of temperature in vacuum.
